n: 4.0 Cu. Ft. Front Load Electric Dryer
desc: Designed to pair seamlessly with our 2.2 cu. ft. Front Load Washer, this front load dryer offers reliable drying performance with a ventless condenser design that simplifies installation. The 4.0 cu. ft. stainless steel drum fits everyday loads, while 15 drying programs and sensor dry technology help prevent over-drying and reduce wrinkles.
hl: 15 Drying Cycles for ideal conditions for any load.
Dries clothes without requiring venting to the outside, providing flexibility in where your dryer is installed.
Reduces wear and tear on clothes due to over-drying by automatically sensing when clothes are dry.
Keeps the drum rotating occasionally after the cycle to prevent clothes from wrinkling.
Resists odors, rust and stains for long-term, reliable performance while the smooth surfaces prevent snags or tears in delicate fabric.
